opening.argument: The title presents First Horse as a 1941 movie to watch online, and the description identifies its subject as a military unit. The sampled black-and-white scenes are consistent with that presentation. The description also makes a general income statement, directs viewers to connect to the Rvision partner program, and requests social-media engagement. But it gives no payout terms, payment requirement, credential request, or deceptive outcome tying those actions to a financial offer. The observable content remains a historical military film entry, not a substantiated financial solicitation.
